Matrix multiplication associative, chain longer sequences Reduce() instead dedicated variadic interface – see example . text: CRAN release: 2025-01-31 Initial CRAN submission. xmap package implements Crossmaps framework transforming numeric data statistical classifications. Crossmap tibbles xmap_tbl encode instructions transforming data associated source classification codes data indexed target classification categories (e.g. agriculture (20%) -> fisheries) source, target weight_by links. two primary functions: Creating crossmap tibbles dataframes links, verifying valid transformations: as_xmap_tbl(= "source_classification", = "target_codes" , weight_by = "distribution_shares) Using validated crossmaps transform data: apply_xmap(.data = source_data, .xmap = source2target_crossmap, values_from = counts) initial release also provides diagnostic functions help debug verification errors: diagnose_as_xmap_tbl() diagnose_apply_xmap()
